faq_lists.title: What services do Bits Collision provide?
faq_lists.content: We provide software, mobile app, web, e-commerce, UI/UX, cloud, digital marketing, AI, and branding solutions.

faq_lists.title: Which industries do you work with?
faq_lists.content: We work with businesses across technology, finance, e-commerce, healthcare, real estate, and other industries.

faq_lists.title: How do I start a project with Bits Collision?
faq_lists.content: Contact us with your requirements. We’ll discuss your goals and guide you through the next steps.

faq_lists.title: How long does a project take?
faq_lists.content: Timelines depend on the project scope, features, complexity, and technology requirements.

faq_lists.title: Do you provide support after launch?
faq_lists.content: Yes. We provide ongoing maintenance, technical support, updates, and optimization.

faq_lists.title: Can you help with digital marketing?
faq_lists.content: Yes. We offer SEO, SEM, social media marketing, AI-powered advertising, and digital marketing strategies.

faq_lists.title: Do you build e-commerce websites?
faq_lists.content: Yes. We create customized e-commerce solutions based on your business requirements.

faq_lists.title: Are you currently hiring?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we welcome talented professionals and regularly look for skilled individuals to join our growing team.

faq_lists.title: How can I apply for a job?
faq_lists.content: You can contact us with your CV and details about your skills and experience.

faq_lists.title: What positions are available?
faq_lists.content: Opportunities may be available in development, design, digital marketing, project management, and other technical roles.

faq_lists.title: Do you offer internships?
faq_lists.content: Yes, Internship Opportunities may be available for motivated individuals looking to gain practical experience.

faq_lists.title: Can I apply for a remote position?
faq_lists.content: Depending on the role on the role, we may offer remote or flexible working opportunities.

faq_lists.title: What skills do you look for?
faq_lists.content: We value technical expertise, creativity, problem-solving, communication, and a willingness to learn.

faq_lists.title: How will I know if I am selected?
faq_lists.content: Our HR team will contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps in the hiring process.

faq_lists.title: How much do your services cost?
faq_lists.content: Pricing depends on your project requirements, features, complexity, and timeline.

faq_lists.title: Do you offer custom pricing?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we create customized plans based on your specific business and project needs.

faq_lists.title: Can I get a free project quote?
faq_lists.content: Yes, share your requirements with us and our team will provide an initial project estimate.

faq_lists.title: What is included in your pricing?
faq_lists.content: Pricing may include design, development, testing, deployment, and support depending on the selected service.

faq_lists.title: Do you require an advance payment?
faq_lists.content: Payment terms depend on the project scope and are discussed and agreed upon before starting the project.

faq_lists.title: Can I change my project requirements?
faq_lists.content: Yes, requirements can be updated during the project, though additional changes may affect the cost and timeline.

faq_lists.title: Do you provide ongoing maintenance plans?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we offer ongoing support and maintenance plans based on your website or software requirements.
